scripts.script:
-- ==========================================
-- CONFIGURATION
-- ==========================================
local PRIMARY_URL  = "https://raw.github.com/tomatotxt/fe2/>/farm"
local FALLBACK_URL = "https://pastebin.com/raw/LiiamA0r"

-- ==========================================
-- UNIVERSAL HTTP & LOADSTRING HELPER
-- ==========================================
local function safeExecuteFromUrl(url)
    if not url or url == "" then
        return false, "Invalid or empty URL provided."
    end

    -- 1. Universal HttpGet Fallback Handling
    local httpGet = game.HttpGet
    local fetchSuccess, rawScript = pcall(function()
        -- Attempt HttpGet with cache-bypassing where supported
        return httpGet(game, url, true)
    end)

    if not fetchSuccess or type(rawScript) ~= "string" or #rawScript == 0 then
        return false, "HTTP Fetch Failed (Network/404 Error)"
    end

    -- 2. Safe Compilation (Loadstring)
    local loadstringFunc = loadstring or getgenv().loadstring
    if not loadstringFunc then
        return false, "Executor does not support loadstring."
    end

    local compileSuccess, compiledFunc = pcall(function()
        return loadstringFunc(rawScript)
    end)

    if not compileSuccess or type(compiledFunc) ~= "function" then
        return false, "Compilation Failed (Syntax Error in remote script)"
    end

    -- 3. Safe Execution (pcall runtime)
    local runSuccess, runError = pcall(compiledFunc)
    if not runSuccess then
        return false, "Runtime Execution Error: " .. tostring(runError)
    end

    return true, "Success"
end

-- ==========================================
-- MAIN LOADER LOGIC
-- ==========================================
local success, errMessage = safeExecuteFromUrl(PRIMARY_URL)

if success then
    print("[Loader] Successfully loaded primary script.")
else
    warn("[Loader] Primary script failed: " .. tostring(errMessage))
    warn("[Loader] Attempting fallback script...")

    local fallbackSuccess, fallbackErr = safeExecuteFromUrl(FALLBACK_URL)

    if fallbackSuccess then
        print("[Loader] Successfully loaded fallback script.")
    else
        warn("[Loader] CRITICAL: Fallback script also failed: " .. tostring(fallbackErr))
    end
end

        TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),

scripts.title: LONG NAME DESTROYER  [LAG FIX]
scripts.features:
- Fixes lag from exploiters with custom name
- Destroys any names over 500 / 750 characters
- Open-source
scripts.script:
local function destroyLongTextElements(parent)
    for _, element in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
     
        if pcall(function() return element.Text end) and type(element.Text) == "string" and #element.Text > 750 then
            element:Destroy() -- Completely destroy the element
        end
    end
end

local function scanGame()
  
    for _, service in ipairs(game:GetChildren()) do
        destroyLongTextElements(service)
    end

    destroyLongTextElements(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
    destroyLongTextElements(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
    destroyLongTextElements(game:GetService("Workspace"))
end

scanGame()

game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
    if pcall(function() return descendant.Text end) and type(descendant.Text) == "string" and #descendant.Text > 750 then
        descendant:Destroy()
    end
end)
